INSERT INTO articles (title, url, source, published_at, category, summary, content)
VALUES ('{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.url.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.source.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.published_at }}', '{{ $json.category.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.summary || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.content || '').substring(0, 50000).replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, title;

meta.notes:
## RSS → Database Ingestion (Native n8n)

Replicates `src/services/rssIngestion.js` entirely inside n8n.

### Pipeline:
1. Triggers every 6h (or manually)
2. Iterates 3 RSS feeds (TechCrunch, Ars Technica, The Verge)
3. Fetches each feed via n8n RSS Feed Read node
4. Normalizes: strips HTML, extracts categories, maps source names
5. Routes articles needing summaries to OpenAI gpt-4o-mini
6. Merges all articles back together
7. Inserts into PostgreSQL with ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING dedup
8. Outputs ingestion summary stats

### Credentials to configure:
- **PostgreSQL**: host=postgres, port=5432, db=ai_news_digest, user=postgres, pw=changeme
- **OpenAI API**: your API key (for LLM summary enrichment)
